Actually, let me reconsider. The OOB read in `sam_hdr_link_pg` happens when old `npg_end > npg`. But I showed `npg_end <= npg` during a single parse. So maybe the OOB read is NOT in `sam_hdr_link_pg` but elsewhere.

Wait, let me reconsider. The fix commit message says "Tolerate PG lines with invalid PP entries". The fix changes `sam_hdr_link_pg` to not return -1 when a PG has a PP to a missing program. And it changes `sam_hdr_rebuild` to fail when `sam_hdr_link_pg` fails.

So the OOB read happens when `sam_hdr_link_pg` returns -1 (due to a PG with PP to missing program), and then `sam_hdr_rebuild` continues (in OLD code) to `sam_hrecs_rebuild_text`. The OOB read must be in `sam_hrecs_rebuild_text`.

Let me look at `sam_hrecs_rebuild_text`.
